prayerExcerpt.en-US: May we never boast, except in the Cross of our Lord Jesus Christ.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Não devemos gloriar-nos a não ser na cruz de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.

meta.face: Andrew: a Vietnamese man of about forty-four with a warm golden complexion and a lean, long-jawed face — high, prominent cheekbones over slightly hollow cheeks, a straight nose with a flat bridge and wide nostrils, calm dark almond eyes under straight, thick black brows, a long, firm jaw and a wide, thin-lipped mouth; clean-shaven, black hair under the khăn đóng, and a gentle, resolute expression. Peter: an elderly Vietnamese priest of about seventy-six, thin and slightly stooped, with a small, narrow face under a high, domed forehead — a small, low-bridged nose, narrow eyes deeply creased at the corners, sparse white brows, hollow cheeks, a small rounded chin and a thin, kind mouth; a sparse white moustache and a wispy white chin beard.
meta.basis: No portrait exists. Vietnamese statues and windows show him clean-shaven in a khăn đóng and long tunic with a stole and palm. Peter Trương Văn Thi (born 1763) was arrested and beheaded with him at Ô Cầu Giấy in 1839, so he is the natural companion; his features are a choice.
